entries.content: Cycle detection utility for config merge operations. Uses WeakSet to track visited objects during deep merge. Throws TypeError with clear message when circular reference detected.

ENOENT error with Chinese file paths on Windows. Root cause: encoding mismatch between GBK (Windows default) and UTF-8 (Node.js default). Fix: Apply Buffer.from(path, 'utf8').toString('ucs2') conversion before file operations, or use fs.promises with explicit encoding.

Performance bottlenecks identified: (1) YAML parsing overhead on large files, (2) schema validation on entire object tree, (3) unnecessary deep copies during merge. Approved solutions: streaming YAML parsing, lazy validation (validate on access), result caching with TTL.

Security requirement: Encrypted config storage for sensitive data (API keys, credentials). Pending decisions: (1) Encryption algorithm - AES-256-GCM vs libsodium, (2) Key management - environment variables vs dedicated key vault service.
